$comment: Drives installer/create-sdd-speckit-app/src/copilot.js, which renders the GitHub Copilot files from the Claude Code sources (commands/, agents/, skills/). Edit the sources, not the rendered output. Formats verified against code.visualstudio.com and docs.github.com on 2026-11-13; see docs/COPILOT.md.

models.$comment: Claude Code tier -> Copilot model name. A tier set to null leaves `model:` out, so Copilot uses whichever model the user picked. Copilot treats the value as a preference and falls back when the model is not enabled for the account.

tools.$comment: Claude Code tool -> Copilot tool-set alias. A tool mapped to null is dropped.

routing.$comment: Command -> custom agents it delegates to, mirrored from docs/ARCHITECTURE.md. A command with disallowed-tools gets '<agent>-readonly' variants that lack those tools.
